newsitem.title: CHINA: More than 60 killed in China coal mine explosion.
newsitem.headline: More than 60 killed in China coal mine explosion.

text.p: A gas explosion has killed more than 60 miners in China's northeastern province of Liaoning, officials said on Monday.
The blast ripped through the Beilongfeng coal mine in Fushun city on May 28, a local mine official said by telephone.
More than 60 people died, the official said but declined to say how many workers were injured or underground during the explosion.
The cause of the explosion was still under investigation.

Explosions and other accidents kill up to 10,000 Chinese miners a year, mainly at badly run village pits. The government has vowed to sack directors of mines in which accidents kill 10 or more people.
